subject: future
topic: AI made average workers faster, and helped the least experienced most
angle: Generative AI improves productivity and creativity for less experienced workers, though it may pose unique challenges for non-experts due to fundamental errors.
title: The End of Experience

hooks.text: You think experts have the edge. The data says otherwise.
You are using a machine to think for you.
A cursor blinks on a white screen.

reveal.headline: AI narrows the gap between skilled and unskilled workers.
reveal.body: Generative AI consistently boosts productivity and quality for lower-skilled or less experienced workers while reducing inequality.

explain.headline: The tools level the playing field.
explain.body: ChatGPT reduces inequality in writing tasks. It causes larger gains for less experienced consumers in online retail and makes stories more creative for less creative writers.

matters.headline: The cost of easier output.
matters.body: That may be why the diversity of novel content is reduced. While you work faster, the unique variety of human expression may become more uniform.

example.headline: A blank screen in a quiet office.
example.body: You sit at your desk at 2 p.m. You type a prompt into a window. A paragraph appears. You delete three words and hit send.

question.headline: Who is the author of your next thought?

stat.label: reduction in average time taken for midlevel professional writing tasks

claims.text: ChatGPT reduced inequality between workers during writing tasks.
claims.quote: Inequality between workers decreased, and concern and excitement about AI temporarily rose.

claims.text: ChatGPT's fundamental errors may pose a special challenge for non-experts.
claims.quote: In light of observed limitations, and given that the tool's fundamental errors may pose a special challenge for non-experts, ChatGPT should be used with a strategic methodology.

claims.text: ChatGPT reduced the average time taken for midlevel professional writing tasks by 40% and increased output quality by 18%.
claims.quote: The average time taken decreased by 40% and output quality rose by 18%.

claims.text: GenAI causes larger gains for less experienced consumers in online retail.
claims.quote: Finally, we document substantial demand-side heterogeneity, with larger gains for less experienced consumers.

claims.text: Access to generative AI ideas causes stories to be evaluated as more creative, better written, and more enjoyable, especially among less creative writers.
claims.quote: We find that access to generative AI ideas causes stories to be evaluated as more creative, better written, and more enjoyable, especially among less creative writers.

claims.text: GitHub Copilot caused developers at Microsoft to complete 12.92% to 21.83% more pull requests per week and 7.51% to 8.69% more at Accenture.
claims.quote: our preliminary results provide suggestive evidence that these developers became more productive, completing 12.92% to 21.83% more pull requests per week at Microsoft and 7.51% to 8.69% at Accenture

verdict: The evidence shows that generative AI consistently boosts productivity and quality for lower-skilled or less experienced workers while reducing inequality.
caveat: While individual productivity and creativity increase, the collective diversity of novel content may be reduced.
caption:
AI is leveling the professional landscape. 

Research shows generative AI boosts productivity and quality for less experienced workers while reducing inequality. However, this increase in efficiency may reduce the collective diversity of novel content. 

How do you feel about the changing nature of your work?
